MOUNTAIN VIEW LOS ALTOS UNION HIGH SCHOOL DISTRICT | AREA 3
# REELECT
THIDA CORNES FOR MVLA SCHOOL BOARD
#### Each and Every Student. Seen. Supported. Set Up to Succeed.
MEET THIDA
I'm Thida Cornes, your Mountain View-Los Altos High School (MVLA) Board President, seeking reelection. This year MVLA moved to trustee areas, and I'm running in Trustee Area 3. I’m a disabled immigrant, a mom, and a longtime Mountain View resident, with my service dog, Jeeves, always by my side.
I navigated both challenges and opportunities during my formative school years. Later I worked full time as an engineering director while earning my MBA from UC Berkeley Haas.
That’s why I’ve dedicate the past four years on the MVLA Board to ensuring every student feels seen, supported, and set up to succeed.
# Three Commitments Guide My Work
MY PRIORITIES
Academic Excellence and Opportunities
### Every Student Succeeds
Students deserve consistent expectations, strong teaching, and the chance to explore their interests and discover their passions.
Connection and Belonging
### Every Student Seen
Every student deserves to walk into class knowing they belong there — and I'm working to make that true for all of them.
Transparency, Teamwork, and Fiscal Responsibility
### An Open, Collaborative and Responsible Board
Our community deserves Trustees that work together for every student, and are open, accessible, and careful with every tax dollar. I have worked hard to earn that trust and will continue to do so.
LEARN MORE ABOUT MY PRIORITIES
## THERE’S MORE TO DO. I’M ASKING FOR THE OPPORTUNITY TO KEEP DOING IT.
#### Vote for Thida on November 3, 2026 — and here's how else you can help.
JOIN TEAM THIDA
DONATE
ENDORSE THIDA

# Who’s Supporting Thida
I'm honored to have the support of our community members (partial list).
Testimonials
## "I see a lot of candidates come and go, and it’s rare that I see someone I can put my full support and my full heart behind. Thida is engaged every single day. I have seen the amount of study she does, the outreach she undertakes, and the care she brings to this work. In difficult and confusing times, we need clear, proactive voices, and Thida brings that thoughtfulness and commitment to her service. I am proud to be her friend and proud to be her supporter."
—Sally Lieber, Chair of the California Board of Equalization; former Speaker Pro Tempore, former Mayor and Mountain View City Council member
## "Mountain View High School’s Latino Parent Outreach (LPO) endorses Thida Cornes. We were impressed with Mrs. Cornes. She reached out to us to hear our concerns as parents, talk to us about her background and priorities, and asked for our endorsement. One in four students in the district is Latino. Sixty percent of Alta Vista students are Latino. The MVLA Adult School serves the larger Latino community. Thida Cornes will make sure every student has the support to thrive"
—Blanca Valencia, President MVHS Latino Parent Outreach
## "Over the years, Thida has continued to prove to me that she is the right person for the job. She regularly shows that she prioritizes students above all else. She cares about all students, whether they need additional support, more challenging courses, or both. Thida was not only an exceptionally smart student, but also a student who needed extra support. She knows how that feels, and she wants to make sure all students get what they need to succeed. For every issue the MVLA Board faces, Thida goes above and beyond in doing her homework. She listens to staff recommendations, talks with stakeholders, listens to public comment, and uses her strong critical-thinking skills to make sure each decision is in the best interest of the district and, most importantly, its students."
—Jessica Speiser, Vice President, Santa Clara County Board of Trustees; MVLA parent
## "I have seen Thida’s positive impact on the Board, supporting high-quality education for every student. I have been so impressed with her ability to really listen to all stakeholders—parents, students, administrators, teachers, and her Board colleagues—and to find solutions that best serve all students. She presents her position on issues before the Board with rationales that rely on evidence and are always consistent with her values of respect for everyone, good governance, and finding solutions that best benefit all students. Thida is smart, wise, and deeply committed to serving all students. I am especially impressed with how she has conducted herself in her role as Board President this year. She has guided the Board through difficult decisions while making sure that different perspectives are heard and understood."
—Cindy Sidaris, Former MVLA Parent
## "I’m proud to endorse Thida Cornes for the Mountain View–Los Altos High School District Board. Thida leads with empathy and a deep commitment to making sure every student feels seen, supported, and valued. I especially admire her advocacy for students with disabilities and LGBTQ+ students, and her willingness to listen to and understand the experiences of students and families whose needs can too easily be overlooked. Thida’s compassion and commitment to inclusive public education make me proud to endorse her continued service."
—Elisabeth Halliday, Campbell Union High School District Trustee
View video of Sophie Baez, MVHS Graduate, First Generation Student
Latino Parent Outreach (LPO) wanted to share this video filmed and produced by two MVHS graduates. The students were asked to film Sophie's journey as an English learner at MVHS because of Thida Cornes’ priority to foster a welcoming and inclusive environment. This video is an affirmation that when every student is seen and supported, they become the best version of themselves.
